title: 第23章 逢凶化吉圣女吃醋第24章 邪魂师圣女担忧女教皇的胸怀
slug: 双生神级武魂震惊妖帝老婆
content_zh:
;;
“有什么问题么？”
洛凡尘听到白莹玥惊呼，心中纳闷，扭头一看。
瞳孔骤缩，吓了大一跳。
小泥鳅原先一米八细长的身躯如今夸张的膨胀着，就像是鼓吹到极致的气球一样，随时都有可能炸开。
体表的双色魂光明灭闪烁，气息极度紊乱。
洛凡尘惊的头皮发麻。
老弟，你特么不是要进化，你这是想不开了要爆炸啊。
顺便想把哥一起带走？
帝薇央凝重的声音从后方传来。
“麻烦了，你这武魂吸收血气和魂环太多，消化不下去了。”
洛凡尘瞥见地上那一整大只风干蛮牛，嘴角抽搐，咱就算嘴馋，也不能一口吃个大胖子吧。
蛇吞大象，纯纯找死。
不过他很快反应过来，小泥鳅没有灵智，所以不可能有节制这个观念，需要他这个主人有意识的控制才行，是他太疏忽了。
“老师，这种情况师哥应该怎么办呀。”白莹玥贝齿紧咬着樱唇，急促询问。
帝薇央面不改色，冷静判断道：“他的武魂外人帮不上忙，只能靠自己处理。”
“唯一的方法就是用本体帮助武魂分担吸收压力，但危机相应也会转移过来。”
“倘若没有这种舍身魄力，便只能放任这武魂自生自灭。”
“明白了。”
洛凡尘听完点头，一个箭步便冲了上去。

眸中闪出果决之色，将手掌按在小泥鳅要炸开的身躯上，小泥鳅乃是崛起资本，又是他的武魂，怎可能放任不管。
一道道澎湃躁动的血气和魂力迅速顺着手掌经脉流入他的身体。
小泥鳅胀大的身躯在缩小，爆炸危机解除，但洛凡尘的身体却鼓胀起来，魂力紊乱。
“咳。”
洛凡尘闷哼一声，嘴角溢出血丝，筋骨中有外来的血气乱窜，经脉内多余的魂力在奔涌。
白莹玥十指紧扣，担心道：“老师，小师哥他……他顶得住么。”
帝薇央红唇开阖。
“无妨，有我在。”
白莹玥心中大定，“既然老师说没事，那一定就没事。”
“不过……”
“老师您刚才不是说外人帮不上忙么。”
帝薇央凤眸斜了她一眼，清冷道：“你话好像有点多。”
白莹玥不敢多言，悻悻的撇了撇柔软小嘴儿。
在注意到帝薇央看着洛凡尘欣赏的目光后，她明白了，老师这分明是在借机会考验师哥。
帝薇央开口道：“临危不乱，处事果决，莹玥，你要学习你师哥的稳重和魄力。”
“人家只是和自己人话多亿点嘛。”

"Is there any problem?"
When Luo Fanchen heard Bai Yingyue's exclamation, he was puzzled and turned around to look.
His pupils shrank suddenly and he was startled.
The little loach's originally slender body of 1.8 meters is now exaggeratedly inflated, like a balloon that has been inflated to the extreme and may explode at any time.
The two-color soul on the body's surface flickers with light, and its aura is extremely disordered.
Luo Fanchen's scalp was numb with shock.
Brother, you're not going to evolve, you're going to explode out of your mind.
Want to take my brother with you by the way?
Di Weiyang's solemn voice came from behind.
"Trouble, your martial soul has absorbed too much blood energy and soul rings, and it can't be digested anymore."
Luo Fanchen caught a glimpse of the big dried beef on the ground, and the corners of his mouth twitched. Even if we are greedy, we can't eat a big fat man in one bite.
A snake swallowing an elephant is simply seeking death.
However, he quickly realized that the little loach had no intelligence, so it was impossible for him to have the concept of restraint. It required conscious control from his master. He was too negligent.
"Teacher, what should senior brother do in this situation?" Bai Yingyue bit her lips tightly and asked hurriedly.
Di Weiyang's face did not change and she calmly judged: "His martial spirit can't be helped by outsiders, so he can only deal with it on his own."
"The only way is to use the body to help the spirit share the absorption pressure, but the crisis will be transferred accordingly."
"If you don't have this kind of courage to sacrifice your life, you can only let this martial spirit fend for itself."
"Got it."
After hearing this, Luo Fanchen nodded and rushed forward in one stride.
With determination flashing in his eyes, he pressed his palm on the body of Little Loach that was about to explode. Little Loach was the capital for his rise and his martial soul, so how could he let it go.
Waves of surging blood and soul power quickly flowed into his body along the meridians of his palms.
The little loach's swollen body was shrinking, and the explosion crisis was resolved, but Luo Fanchen's body was swollen, and his soul power was disordered.
"Ahem."
Luo Fanchen groaned, bloodshot eyes overflowing from the corners of his mouth, foreign blood and energy rushed in his muscles and bones, and excess soul power surged in his meridians.
Bai Yingyue clasped her fingers together and said worriedly: "Teacher, little senior brother... can he withstand it?"
Di Weiyang's red lips opened and closed.
"It doesn't matter, I'm here."
Bai Yingyue was determined, "Since the teacher said it's okay, then it must be okay."
"But..."
"Teacher, didn't you just say that outsiders can't help?"
Di Weiyang glanced at her with phoenix eyes and said coldly: "You seem to talk a bit too much."
Bai Yingyue didn't dare to say anything, and pouted her soft mouth angrily.
After noticing Di Weiyang's admiring look at Luo Fanchen, she understood that the teacher was clearly taking the opportunity to test her senior brother.
Di Weiyang said: "Be calm in the face of danger and be decisive in dealing with things. Yingyue, you must learn from your senior brother's stability and courage."
"People just talk to their own people more."
